let customTables = Usage
| where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})

| project ['Log Type'] = DataType, ['Table Size'] = size, ['Estimated Cost'] = size*{Price};

## Free Sentinel Data Summary

Microsoft documents the following Sentinel data sources as free:

- Azure Activity Logs (`AzureActivity`)
- Health monitoring for Microsoft Sentinel (`SentinelHealth`)
- Microsoft 365 audit activity (`OfficeActivity`)
- Microsoft Entra ID Protection alerts (`SecurityAlert`)
- Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Defender for IoT alerts (`SecurityAlert`)
- Microsoft Defender XDR incidents and alerts (`SecurityIncident`, `SecurityAlert`)
- Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, and Office 365 alerts (`SecurityAlert`)

This section estimates Analytics-tier ingestion in the selected workspace scope and keeps it separate from billable ingestion. It does not estimate data lake-only ingestion, storage, processing, or query charges. Usage is grouped by table and cannot reliably identify the originating connector, so `SecurityAlert` cannot be allocated reliably among its contributing services. This estimate does not calculate the separate Sentinel free trial. Review the [Microsoft Sentinel free data sources](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/billing?tabs=simplified%2Ccommitment-tiers#free-data-sources) documentation for current eligibility and billing terms.

## Microsoft Sentinel benefit for Microsoft 365 E7/E5/A5/F5/G5 customers

Qualifying Microsoft 365 E7, E5, A5, F5, and G5 licenses, and corresponding Security licenses, may receive a Microsoft Sentinel data grant of up to 5 MB per qualifying user per day for eligible Microsoft 365 data.

Eligible data-source groups include:

- Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit logs (`SigninLogs`, `AuditLogs`, `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs`, `AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs`, `AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs`, `AADProvisioningLogs`, `ADFSSignInLogs`, `AADUserRiskEvents`, `AADRiskyUsers`)
- Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps Guard shadow IT discovery logs (`McasShadowItReporting`)
- Microsoft Purview Information Protection logs (`InformationProtectionLogs_CL`)
- Microsoft 365 advanced hunting data (the eligible `Device*`, `Email*`, `Identity*`, `AlertEvidence`, and `CloudAppEvents` tables shown below)

This workbook estimates the Analytics-tier ingestion benefit from billable Usage data in the selected workspace scope. It does not estimate data lake-only charges or prove that a row came from an eligible connector, that the offer applies to your agreement, or that the calculated amount matches billing. The grant cap is modeled once across the selected scope; it is not multiplied per workspace.

Review the [Microsoft 365 Sentinel benefit offer](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/offers/sentinel-microsoft-365-offer/) for current eligibility, agreement terms, and supported data types. Enter **Total Microsoft 365 E7/E5/A5/F5/G5 seats** below and use the global **Ingestion price** to calculate the estimate.

## Microsoft Sentinel benefit for Defender for Servers Plan 2

Defender for Servers Plan 2 provides up to 500 MB of eligible Analytics-tier ingestion per protected server or node per day. The allowance is pooled across machines in each subscription and applied at workspace level. This workbook estimates observed usage; it does not prove Plan 2 protection, licensing, eligibility, or data lake-only charges.

Core eligible tables:

- `SecurityAlert`, `SecurityBaseline`, `SecurityBaselineSummary`, `SecurityDetection`, `SecurityEvent`
- `WindowsFirewall`, `ProtectionStatus`, `MDCFileIntegrityMonitoringEvents`
- `DeviceCustomFileEvents`, `DeviceCustomRegistryEvents`

Conditionally eligible tables:

- `Update`, `UpdateSummary`: review the applicable Update Management conditions
- `WindowsEvent`: only security data from the Microsoft-SecurityEvent stream

Nodes is the distinct `Computer` count observed in `Heartbeat`, not proof of licensing or Plan 2 protection. Review the [Defender for Servers Plan 2 data ingestion benefit](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/defender-for-cloud/data-ingestion-benefit) for current eligibility and terms.

## Retention summary

This section estimates Analytics-tier charges for billable data retained longer than 90 days, using historical billable workspace records. XDR and data lake retention use separate billing models. Review [Manage data tiers and retention in Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/manage-data-overview) for retention and data-tier guidance.

parameters.name: RetentionPrice
parameters.label: Retention price
parameters.description: Enter the retention price per GB/month used for this section's estimates.

content.query: let retainedDataGB = toreal(coalesce(toscalar((union withsource = SourceTableName * | where TimeGenerated < startofday(now()) - 90d | where _IsBillable == true | summarize sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0)), 0.0)); print ['Average Daily Retention Cost'] = retainedDataGB * todouble('{RetentionPrice}') / 30.0
content.title: Average Daily Retention Cost
content.noDataMessage: No retained billable data was found in the selected workspace scope.

content.query: let selectedDays = max_of(datetime_diff('second', {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:start}) / 86400.0, 1.0); let retainedDataGB = toreal(coalesce(toscalar((union withsource = SourceTableName * | where TimeGenerated < startofday(now()) - 90d | where _IsBillable == true | summarize sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0)), 0.0)); print ['Retention Cost'] = retainedDataGB * todouble('{RetentionPrice}') * selectedDays / 30.0
content.title: Retention Cost: {TimeRange}
content.noDataMessage: No retained billable data was found in the selected workspace scope.

content.query: let selectedDays = max_of(datetime_diff('second', {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:start}) / 86400.0, 1.0); union withsource = SourceTableName * | where TimeGenerated < startofday(now()) - 90d | where _IsBillable == true | summarize RetainedDataGB = sum(_BilledSize) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0 by SourceTableName | project ['Log Type'] = SourceTableName, ['Retained Data'] = RetainedDataGB, ['Average Daily Retention Cost'] = RetainedDataGB * todouble('{RetentionPrice}') / 30.0, ['Retention Cost'] = RetainedDataGB * todouble('{RetentionPrice}') * selectedDays / 30.0 | order by ['Retained Data'] desc
content.title: Retained data by source table in the last {TimeRange}
content.noDataMessage: No billable data older than 90 days was found in the selected workspace scope.

content.json:
## Commitment tiers

Microsoft Sentinel and Log Analytics offer Pay-As-You-Go and Commitment Tier pricing. This section automatically detects the current workspace tier and calculates a **usage-based suggested tier** from average billable daily ingestion over the last 31 days.

> **New workspace notice:** A recommendation is shown only after 31 days of billable data are detected. Until then, the table reports how many days remain before the recommendation becomes available; a shorter history cannot accurately represent the fixed 31-day review period.

> **Estimate only:** The suggested tier uses ingestion volume, not actual pricing. It is not the Azure portal **Recommended Tier** and should not be used as the sole basis for a pricing change. Azure evaluates each available tier using the prior 31 days and your applicable pricing to identify the lowest estimated-cost option. Review [Usage and estimated costs in the Azure portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/change-pricing-tier#changing-pricing-tier) before changing a tier.

Review **Days since tier last changed** before making a change: a commitment tier has a 31-day period during which it cannot move to a lower commitment or consumption tier. Confirm rates on the [Microsoft Sentinel pricing page](https://www.microsoft.com/security/pricing/microsoft-sentinel/) and review [Plan costs and understand pricing and billing for Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/billing?tabs=simplified%2Ccommitment-tiers#analytics-tier).

parameters.name: CurrentCommitmentTier
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| where id in~ ({Workspace}) or 'value::all' in~ ({Workspace})
| extend skuName = tolower(tostring(properties.sku.name)), capacityReservationLevel = toint(properties.sku.capacityReservationLevel)
| extend currentTier = case(skuName == 'capacityreservation', strcat(tostring(capacityReservationLevel), ' GB/day commitment'), skuName == 'pergb2018', 'Pay-As-You-Go', skuName == 'free', 'Free tier', skuName == 'standalone', 'Standalone tier', skuName == 'standard', 'Standard tier', skuName == 'premium', 'Premium tier', 'Unknown')
| summarize WorkspaceCount = dcount(id), CurrentTier = any(currentTier)
| project CurrentCommitmentTier = iif(WorkspaceCount == 1, CurrentTier, 'Multiple workspaces')

content.query: let reviewDays = 31.0; let reviewStart = ago(31d); let historyProbeStart = ago(32d); let currentTier = '{CurrentCommitmentTier}'; let tierLevels = dynamic([50,100,200,300,400,500,1000,2000,5000]); union withsource = SourceTableName * | where TimeGenerated between (historyProbeStart .. now()) | where _IsBillable == true | summarize TotalBilledBytes = sumif(_BilledSize, TimeGenerated >= reviewStart), FirstObserved = min(TimeGenerated) | extend ObservedHistoryDays = iif(isnull(FirstObserved), 0.0, min_of(reviewDays, datetime_diff('second', now(), FirstObserved) / 86400.0)) | extend DaysRemaining = toint(ceiling(max_of(reviewDays - ObservedHistoryDays, 0.0))) | extend AvgDailyGB = iif(DaysRemaining == 0, TotalBilledBytes / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / reviewDays, real(null)), TierLevels = tierLevels | mv-expand TierLevel = TierLevels to typeof(int) | extend IsEligible = TierLevel >= AvgDailyGB | summarize SuggestedTierGBPerDay = minif(TierLevel, IsEligible), AvgDailyGB = any(AvgDailyGB), ObservedHistoryDays = any(ObservedHistoryDays), DaysRemaining = any(DaysRemaining) | extend suggestedTier = case(DaysRemaining > 0, strcat('Available in ', tostring(DaysRemaining), iif(DaysRemaining == 1, ' day', ' days')), AvgDailyGB < 50.0, 'Pay-As-You-Go', isnotempty(SuggestedTierGBPerDay), strcat(tostring(SuggestedTierGBPerDay), ' GB/day commitment'), 'Above 5000 GB/day - review Azure portal options') | extend alignmentStatus = case(DaysRemaining > 0, 'Collecting data', currentTier == 'Not available' or currentTier == 'Unknown' or currentTier == 'Multiple workspaces', 'Not evaluated', suggestedTier startswith 'Above 5000 GB/day', 'Review in portal', currentTier == suggestedTier, 'Aligned', 'Review tier') | project ['Current tier'] = currentTier, ['Recommended next tier'] = suggestedTier, ['Alignment status'] = alignmentStatus, ['Observed history (days)'] = round(ObservedHistoryDays, 1), ['Days until recommendation'] = DaysRemaining, ['Average billable daily ingestion (GB)'] = round(AvgDailyGB, 2)
content.title: Usage-based suggested tier (estimate, last 31 days)
content.noDataMessage: No billable ingestion was found in the last 31 days.

content.json:
## Microsoft Sentinel Data Lake

The data lake stores security data outside the Analytics tier and is billed on five separate meters. Enter your rates below from the [Microsoft Sentinel pricing page](https://www.microsoft.com/security/pricing/microsoft-sentinel/); the defaults are placeholders and must be verified against your agreement and region.

**What this section can and cannot observe.** Only the storage meter can be derived per table from workspace data:

| Meter | Source | Per-table detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Data lake storage | Estimated from mirrored `Usage` volume | Yes |
| Data lake ingestion | Manual entry | No |
| Data processing | Manual entry | No |
| Data lake query | Manual entry | No |
| Advanced data insights | Manual entry | No |

When the data lake is enabled, Analytics-tier data is **mirrored** to the lake at no extra ingestion charge, so mirrored volume is visible in `Usage` and is used for the storage estimate. Ingestion and data processing are charged only for tables set to **data lake tier only**; that data never reaches the Analytics workspace, so its volume must be entered manually. Query charges depend on GB scanned and insights charges on notebook compute hours, neither of which is recorded in `Usage`.

Storage is billed on compressed data at a documented **6:1** ratio and applies only to data still retained after the Analytics retention period ends. These are planning estimates, not invoice values. Validate in **Microsoft Sentinel > Cost management** in the Microsoft Defender portal, and review the [data lake overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/datalake/sentinel-lake-overview), [billing model](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/billing#understand-the-full-billing-model-for-microsoft-sentinel), and [cost monitoring guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/billing-monitor-costs).

parameters.name: LakeStoragePrice
parameters.label: Lake storage price (per compressed GB/month)
parameters.description: Data lake storage rate per compressed GB per month. Storage is billed at a 6:1 compression ratio on data retained after Analytics retention ends.

parameters.name: LakeAnalyticsRetentionDays
parameters.label: Analytics retention (days)
parameters.description: Analytics-tier retention in days. Lake storage is charged only for data retained beyond this period.

paramValidationRules.message: Enter a whole number of days greater than zero.

parameters.name: LakeTotalRetentionMonths
parameters.label: Total lake retention (months)
parameters.description: Total retention in the data lake tier, up to 12 years (144 months).

paramValidationRules.message: Enter a whole number of months greater than zero.

parameters.name: LakeOnlyIngestionGB
parameters.label: Lake-only ingestion (GB/month)
parameters.description: Monthly GB ingested into tables set to data lake tier only. This data is not present in the Analytics workspace, so it cannot be measured here. Leave as <unset> to report N/A.

paramValidationRules.message: Enter a non-negative number, or clear the value.

parameters.name: LakeIngestionPrice
parameters.label: Lake ingestion price (per GB)
parameters.description: Ingestion rate per GB for tables set to data lake tier only. Mirrored data is not charged this meter.

parameters.name: LakeProcessingPrice
parameters.label: Data processing price (per GB)
parameters.description: Data processing rate per GB for tables set to data lake tier only, covering transformations such as redaction, splitting, filtering, and normalization.

parameters.name: LakeQueryScannedGB
parameters.label: Lake query data scanned (GB/month)
parameters.description: Monthly GB of uncompressed data scanned by KQL queries and jobs against the lake. Not recorded in the workspace. Leave as <unset> to report N/A.

paramValidationRules.message: Enter a non-negative number, or clear the value.

parameters.name: LakeQueryPrice
parameters.label: Lake query price (per GB scanned)
parameters.description: Query rate per GB of uncompressed data scanned in the data lake tier.

parameters.name: LakeInsightsHours
parameters.label: Advanced data insights (compute hours/month)
parameters.description: Monthly notebook and job compute hours for advanced data insights. Not recorded in the workspace. Leave as <unset> to report N/A.

paramValidationRules.message: Enter a non-negative number, or clear the value.

parameters.name: LakeInsightsPrice
parameters.label: Advanced data insights price (per compute hour)
parameters.description: Rate per compute hour for advanced data insights sessions and jobs.

content.query: let selectedDays = max_of(datetime_diff('second', {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:start}) / 86400.0, 1.0); Usage | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | summarize ['Average Daily Mirrored Volume'] = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 / selectedDays
content.title: Average Daily Mirrored Volume
content.noDataMessage: No billable table usage data was found in the selected time range.

content.query: Usage | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | summarize ['Mirrored Volume'] = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0
content.title: Mirrored Volume: {TimeRange}
content.noDataMessage: No billable table usage data was found in the selected time range.

content.query: let compressionRatio = 6.0; let selectedDays = max_of(datetime_diff('second', {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:start}) / 86400.0, 1.0); let chargeableDays = max_of(todouble('{LakeTotalRetentionMonths}') * 30.0 - todouble('{LakeAnalyticsRetentionDays}'), 0.0); Usage | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | summarize RawGB = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 | extend ['Billed Compressed Volume'] = RawGB / selectedDays * chargeableDays / compressionRatio | project ['Billed Compressed Volume']
content.title: Est. Lake Storage at Steady State
content.noDataMessage: No mirrored table usage data was found in the selected time range.

content.query: let compressionRatio = 6.0; let selectedDays = max_of(datetime_diff('second', {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:start}) / 86400.0, 1.0); let chargeableDays = max_of(todouble('{LakeTotalRetentionMonths}') * 30.0 - todouble('{LakeAnalyticsRetentionDays}'), 0.0); Usage | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | summarize RawGB = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 | extend ['Estimated Monthly Storage Cost'] = RawGB / selectedDays * chargeableDays / compressionRatio * todouble('{LakeStoragePrice}') | project ['Estimated Monthly Storage Cost']
content.title: Est. Monthly Lake Storage Cost
content.noDataMessage: No mirrored table usage data was found in the selected time range.

content.query: let compressionRatio = 6.0; let selectedDays = max_of(datetime_diff('second', {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:start}) / 86400.0, 1.0); let chargeableDays = max_of(todouble('{LakeTotalRetentionMonths}') * 30.0 - todouble('{LakeAnalyticsRetentionDays}'), 0.0); Usage | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | summarize RawGB = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 by DataType | extend AvgDailyRawGB = RawGB / selectedDays | extend RetainedRawGB = AvgDailyRawGB * chargeableDays | extend CompressedGB = RetainedRawGB / compressionRatio | project ['Log Type'] = DataType, ['Avg Daily Volume'] = AvgDailyRawGB, ['Lake Retained Volume'] = RetainedRawGB, ['Billed Compressed Volume'] = CompressedGB, ['Monthly Storage Cost'] = CompressedGB * todouble('{LakeStoragePrice}') | order by ['Monthly Storage Cost'] desc
content.title: Estimated data lake storage cost by table (steady state at {LakeTotalRetentionMonths}-month retention)
content.noDataMessage: No mirrored table usage data was found in the selected time range.

content.query: let lakeOnlyGB = todouble('{LakeOnlyIngestionGB}'); let queryScannedGB = todouble('{LakeQueryScannedGB}'); let insightsHours = todouble('{LakeInsightsHours}'); union (print SortOrder = 1, Meter = 'Data lake ingestion', Basis = 'Lake-tier-only tables, not visible in the workspace', Volume = lakeOnlyGB, Unit = 'GB/month', Cost = lakeOnlyGB * todouble('{LakeIngestionPrice}')), (print SortOrder = 2, Meter = 'Data processing', Basis = 'Lake-tier-only tables, not visible in the workspace', Volume = lakeOnlyGB, Unit = 'GB/month', Cost = lakeOnlyGB * todouble('{LakeProcessingPrice}')), (print SortOrder = 3, Meter = 'Data lake query', Basis = 'Uncompressed data scanned by KQL queries and jobs', Volume = queryScannedGB, Unit = 'GB/month', Cost = queryScannedGB * todouble('{LakeQueryPrice}')), (print SortOrder = 4, Meter = 'Advanced data insights', Basis = 'Notebook and job compute time', Volume = insightsHours, Unit = 'hours/month', Cost = insightsHours * todouble('{LakeInsightsPrice}')) | order by SortOrder asc | project Meter, ['Billing basis'] = Basis, ['Entered volume'] = iif(isnull(Volume), 'Not set', strcat(tostring(round(Volume, 2)), ' ', Unit)), ['Estimated monthly cost'] = iif(isnull(Cost), 'N/A - enter a volume above', strcat('$', tostring(round(Cost, 2))))
content.title: Data lake meters that cannot be measured from the workspace

content.query: let selectedDuration = {TimeRange:end} - {TimeRange:start}; let timeGrain = case(selectedDuration <= 1h, 5m, selectedDuration <= 4h, 15m, selectedDuration <= 1d, 1h, selectedDuration <= 7d, 6h, selectedDuration <= 31d, 1d, selectedDuration <= 90d, 7d, 30d); Usage | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | summarize ['Mirrored Volume'] = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 by bin(TimeGenerated, timeGrain) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Mirrored Volume in the {TimeRange}
content.noDataMessage: No mirrored table usage data was found in the selected time range.

content.json:
## SOAR summary

Microsoft Sentinel playbooks use Azure Logic Apps to automate responses to incidents, alerts, and other security operations workflows. This section automatically discovers accessible Logic Apps and summarizes billable executions from Azure Monitor metrics.

All accessible subscriptions and resource groups are included by default, and the first 10 discovered Logic Apps are selected with concrete resource IDs. Use the Logic Apps control to change or expand that selection. The execution table updates directly from the selected Logic Apps and time range. Select a row to calculate the estimated automation cost for that scope using the **Logic App execution cost** value below. It does not query the `AzureMetrics` table and is not affected when `AzureMetrics` is configured as Basic Logs.

Review [Automate threat response with playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/automation/automate-responses-with-playbooks) for playbook guidance. Because playbooks use Azure Logic Apps, additional charges can apply. Go to the [Azure Logic Apps](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/logic-apps/) pricing page for more details.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type in~ ({ResourceTypes})
| summarize Count = count() by subscriptionId, resourceGroup
| order by Count desc
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/', resourceGroup), label = resourceGroup

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.label: Logic Apps
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type in~ ({ResourceTypes})
| extend resourceGroupId = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/', resourceGroup)
| where resourceGroupId in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| order by name asc
| extend Rank = row_number()
| project value = id, label = tostring(name), selected = Rank <= 10, group = resourceGroup

parameters.name: ExecutionCost
parameters.label: Logic App execution cost
parameters.description: Enter the cost per Logic App execution used for the SOAR estimate.

content.title: Logic App billable executions in the {TimeRange}
content.noDataMessage: No Logic App metric data is available for the selected scope and time range. Confirm that the Logic Apps are accessible, then expand the time range or choose a narrower scope.

content.json: > **N/A:** No Logic App metric row is selected. Select a Logic App or subscription rollup above after metric data loads. If the grid is empty, confirm access to the selected Logic Apps and try a wider time range.

content.query: print ['Total billable executions'] = todouble('{Total}')
content.title: Total billable executions: selected scope

content.query: print ['Estimated automation cost'] = todouble('{Total}') * todouble('{ExecutionCost}')
content.title: Estimated automation cost: selected scope
